description.value: HAAN Korean BBQ is an authentic Korean barbecue restaurant located in Sunwood Square near Coquitlam Centre, where diners cook their own selection of beef or pork on smokeless tabletop grills. Every meal comes with traditional Banchan side dishes, and the kitchen also prepares fully cooked dishes for those who prefer. It is a full sit-down dining experience with a drink menu and staff on hand to guide first-timers.
